deterministic_assertions: both wishbone link radii remain constant within 1e-6 mm
upright lower-to-upper spherical-joint distance remains constant within 1e-6 mm
circle-intersection branch remains continuous and nonsingular across the full sweep
shock length is reported as variable and is not used as a closure constraint
rear toe-link length remains constant and provisional absolute rear toe stays at or below 1 degree
front tie rod reaches the declared fixed x/z rack corridor in every pose
halfshaft length and angle are reported but never converted into a hardware PASS without measured supplier limits
no STL or printable-part claim is emitted from this skeleton phase
known_blockers: chassis v1 has y-axis pivot bores and solid regions in the required x-axis wishbone paths
ball joint, shock, hub/bearing, wheel backspacing, halfshaft articulation and steering actuator interfaces are unmeasured
the lower and upper outer joints lie inside a full-width tire proxy; measured rim cavity and offset are required
a 57.5 mm tire radius cannot share the nominal radius-45 ground datum without changing static ride height
no strength, material, fatigue, load or safety claim follows from the point model
